description: This file is a shell script snippet intended to be sourced by other shell scripts for Git repository setup and utility functions. It includes variable setup, function definitions for Git operations, environment configuration, and platform-specific tweaks.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Terminates the script execution with an error message and status 1.

methods.name: die_with_status
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits with provided status code.

methods.name: set_reflog_action
methods.description: Sets the GIT_REFLOG_ACTION environment variable if not already set.

methods.name: git_editor
methods.description: Determines the Git editor command and executes it with passed arguments.

methods.name: git_pager
methods.description: Determines and runs the Git pager command, defaulting to 'cat' if output is not a terminal.

methods.name: is_bare_repository
methods.description: Checks if the current directory is a bare Git repository.

methods.name: cd_to_toplevel
methods.description: Changes current directory to the top-level of the Git working tree.

methods.name: require_work_tree_exists
methods.description: Ensures the current repository has a working tree; exits with error if not.

methods.name: require_work_tree
methods.description: Ensures the current directory is inside a Git working tree.

methods.name: require_clean_work_tree
methods.description: Checks for unstaged or uncommitted changes; exits if such changes are present.

methods.name: pick_ident_script
methods.description: Generates a sed script to extract identity information from a raw commit.

methods.name: parse_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Produces a sed script that can parse identity information from commit input.

methods.name: get_author_ident_from_commit
methods.description: Retrieves author identity details from a specific commit.

methods.name: create_virtual_base
methods.description: Creates a virtual base file for merging using common lines with another file.

methods.name: git_dir_init
methods.description: Initializes variables related to Git directory paths and verifies repository structure.

methods.name: peel_committish
methods.description: Resolves a commitish to a commit object, verifying the existence.
